translations.translatedText: # Saturday 31.12.2022 (radio)
Emeritus Pope Benedict has died. The New Year is being celebrated around the world and in Finland. Share prices fell on the Helsinki Stock Exchange in 2022. The weather is becoming sunnier.
## Pope Benedict
![Picture of Pope Benedict in a church.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5760,h_3240,x_0,y_370/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-105374163ac9d672f416/1672480011)
Open image viewer
Photo: Michael Folmer / AOP
The former head of the Catholic Church, Pope Benedict, has died. The 95-year-old pope died in the morning in the Vatican.
Benedict resigned from the papacy in 2013 because he was not well. Benedict was the first pope in 600 years who did not continue in the office of pope until his death.
Pope Benedict was born in Germany and his name was Joseph Ratzinger. He became pope in spring 2005.
The current pope is the Argentinian Francis.
## New Year
![Fireworks for sale.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_114/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-105328263aaf5881797f/1672148492)
Open image viewer
Photo: Matti Myller / Yle
The New Year is celebrated in various parts of the world.

The year 2023 first began on the Pacific islands of Kiribati and Samoa. The year changed in the island states at 12 noon Finnish time. In Australia and New Zealand there were big fireworks when the year changed.
The city of Helsinki is cancelling New Year's fireworks because the weather is windy. Fireworks will be held in many other Finnish towns.
People may fire their own fireworks between 18:00 and 02:00. However, many towns have restricted the areas where fireworks may be fired.
The New Year celebration held at Kansalaistori in Helsinki can be followed as a live broadcast on TV1 and Yle Areena from 22:50.
## Sanna Marin
![Sanna Marin's profile picture.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_367/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-105447263af0fbd68411/1672417238)
Open image viewer
Photo: Nicolas Economou / All Over Press
Prime Minister Sanna Marin has sent a New Year's greeting. She says that Finland's decision to join the military alliance NATO was good. In Marin's opinion Finland's position has improved.
Prime Minister Sanna Marin also urged everyone to vote in the spring parliamentary elections.
## Helsinki Stock Exchange

![The graphic shows how the general index OMXHPI of the Helsinki Stock Exchange developed in 2022. The index was already falling early in the year and collapsed especially after Russia attacked Ukraine. At the end of the year the index has recovered somewhat.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3404,h_1914,x_1911,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-105445463aef362332c2/1672410044)
Open image viewer
Photo: Silja Viitala / Yle, graphic: Samuli Huttunen / Yle

On the Helsinki Stock Exchange, share prices fell by an average of about 16 percent during 2022. Among Finnish companies, for example, Nokian Tyres and Fortum were in trouble. The share of Nokian Tyres fell by over 70 percent in 2022 and Fortum's by well over 40 percent.
Share prices have been affected, for example, by Russia's attack on Ukraine and the rise in the prices of goods and services.
## The weather

![Electronic signs above the motorway show the weather.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3251,h_1828,x_439,y_681/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-105356363ac2bdd96046/1672227887)
Open image viewer
Photo: Heini Rautoma / Yle
The weather on Sunday is fair in southern and central Finland. In many places the sun shines. In the northern part of the country it is cloudy and in many places it still snows.
The temperature is between +1 and -5 degrees.
On the roads the driving conditions are poor or very poor, mainly in the eastern and northern parts of the country. Pavements are slippery in many places.
